on_body: src/main/java/io/github/longshou/mcyukkuri/client/CareWearRenderer.java (procedural shells built from an interpolated body radius profile; each ring's radii taken to the convex hull of the posed samples at their true angles; cloth swaddle on the body alone (hanging hair falls over it) in eight styles of item.SwaddleStyle: fabric tile tinted by vertex colour, rolled cuff, lace frill or plain hem, crossover flap with a bow, back initial, tiger mark, rubber sole with strap and pouch, pompoms (swaddle_trim); leaf swaddle as one leaf worn like a diaper from the anus at the back, under the body, up over the front outlet below the mouth, radii including the hair hanging at the back, stool-stained cells from the bottom up, laid flat under the child while opened for care); client/LeashLoopRenderer.java draws the lead's rope loop round the drawn body and its back knot from pose/LeashRing (the ring is fitted once at rest to body skin points and re-skinned per frame, so it follows every pose; no hair is encircled, and where hair hugs the body the rope sinks under it), sampling leash_rope
role: 16x16 item sprites (item/generated); the same sprite is drawn in GUI, hand, ground and mouth. swaddle_cloth is drawn in the vanilla item style of supplies.py, one icon per style picked by the item model's swaddle_style override; the leaf swaddle is made in the world by parents and has no item
